desc: Ideation and approach selection: use DSU over present values with a first-present-divisor marker for each multiple up to `threshold`.
Implement the DSU multiples approach with `first[m]` storing the first present divisor index seen for multiple `m`.
Ensure values greater than `threshold` are never unioned and remain isolated components.
Validate on the provided examples and edge cases: `nums = [1]`, `threshold = 1`, all values greater than `threshold`, value exactly equal to `threshold`, and many small present values.
